decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the firm's secure-ecosystem strategy and costs little to maintain inside the existing platform, so it remains worth keeping even though it no longer appears on the website.
Mobile PDF signing still supports the firm's move into online contract signing and is cheap to keep as a feature, though its absence from the website since 2020 suggests limited standalone value.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture underpins the other offers, so dropping it would give up many follow-on options at little saving.
Four years after launch, the niche email-to-app delivery robot has dropped from view, which signals weak uptake, so its value is unlikely to be realized and its resources are better redeployed.
